answers.how: the request says the SO-1.01 design record is owned by a named work lane: that is the label of another agent, and a signed contract is immutable, so the label would be permanent. Replace it with a neutral phrase such as "the owner of SO-1.01"

the manifest row lists depends_on SO-05 and SO-06 while the request cites SO-05-A and SO-06-A; those ids are vault contracts, not manifest rows, so the dependency is not machine-checked and the two spellings disagree

T4 R2 says none of the eight functions is called outside project-state.mjs, which is true of the base of pull request #326 and false of its head fc6df28; say "on the base of #326" so the sentence is not read as present tense
